review.note: 2026-11-13 h2h-dev-tools 0.13.0 dependency review. Official PyPI/npm metadata checked at 2026-11-13T05:11:52Z reports hatchling 1.33.0, distlib 0.4.4, packaging 26.3, build 1.6.1, mypy 2.4.1, pytest 9.2.0, pytest-xdist 3.8.0, ruff 0.17.5 and markdownlint-cli2 0.24.1. All latest stable releases satisfy the unchanged lower-only bounds; no out-of-bound stable candidate exists. Declared minimum releases are not yanked and their metadata admits Python 3.14; latest metadata also admits 3.14. Distlib has a 3.14 classifier but no Requires-Python field; pytest-xdist declares >=3.9 without a 3.14 classifier or explicit 3.14 release-note support. These are metadata observations, not execution proof. Markdownlint-cli2 minimum and latest both require Node >=22. Reviewed official notes for hatchling Python 3.15/plugin-interface changes, distlib launcher/archive hardening, packaging marker/specifier corrections, build Windows symlink regression repair, mypy native-parser/overload changes, pytest plugin exit codes/hash-based rewritten caches/parametrize and cache changes, xdist loadscope ordering, Ruff 0.17 defaults plus 0.17.4-0.17.5 parser/BOM/stderr/autofix/B008 changes, and markdownlint-cli2 dependency updates. Existing explicit Ruff py314/rule settings remain relevant. No concrete incompatibility requiring a new upper bound or exclusion was identified. This read-only review performed no dependency installation, tests, registry-backed clean resolution or native Windows validation; normal candidate fast/full/artifact gates remain separate evidence.
